previous.note: September 20 pin; the installed application moved to upstream 19.1.0 by September 24.

rows.mapping: Core titles/notes/timestamps/dates/estimates map transactionally; unsupported metadata blocks apply. Source IDs remain provenance, not destination IDs.
rows.acceptance: Review/apply/replay imported tasks; original timestamps and notes match, changed source cannot overwrite destination edits.
rows.offlineSync: Core task outbox exists; plannedStart remains calendar-authoritative.

rows.mapping: parentId/subTaskIds import as full two-level child tasks in source order with notes, dates, estimates, completion and provenance (ADR 0018). Deeper chains block apply. Parent estimates are derived and kept in provenance; parent time totals wait for #41.
rows.acceptance: Preserve ordered parent/child identity and all child fields; test move/reorder/cycles and parent/leaf totals.
rows.offlineSync: task.move queues offline with a parent-version base; stale or invalid moves become resource conflicts that change nothing. Child creation offline is create then move.

rows.mapping: Colour, icon, order, hide-from-menu, completion (archives, SP 19.1.0), archive/restore and per-project backlog membership are stored, edited and imported (#28, ADR 0019). menuTree order applies; folders are deferred to #63 and reported. Task order inside a project remains provenance only.
rows.acceptance: Archive/restore and complete/reopen keep task assignments; stale reorder and backlog moves conflict; imported isDone/doneOn/isArchived/backlog/noteIds replay idempotently. Remaining: menu folders (#63) and in-project task order.
rows.offlineSync: New project fields ride the existing project snapshots in the sync change feed and are cached read-only; writes are online HTTP until #92.

rows.mapping: Colour, icon, order and archive/restore are stored and imported; TODAY, EM_URGENT, EM_IMPORTANT and KANBAN_IN_PROGRESS are derived views or board markers, never ordinary tags (TODAY order: #29; markers: #63).
rows.acceptance: Distinguish virtual views, archived tags and task membership; verify case/identity behavior, stale reorder conflicts and import of colour/icon/archive state.
rows.offlineSync: Tag fields ride the existing tag snapshots; assignment and lifecycle writes remain online HTTP until #92.

rows.mapping: Today queue, timed blocks and date-only planned days (dueDay, owner time zone, exclusive with dueWithTime) exist per ADR 0020. Persisted Today/planner-day order, daily rituals, schedule hygiene and automatic planning still need parity.
rows.acceptance: Exercise plan-today/order/reschedule/clear/finish-day and date-only workflows with imported data, including DST.
rows.offlineSync: Planned day is online-only like planned start (ADR 0020); snapshots carry it, sync v2 operations do not. Offline planning edits remain #92.

rows.mapping: Both stores apply as read-only archived tasks with original created/doneOn times and hierarchy (#38, ADR 0022). Missing projects, tags, repeat configurations and parents and priority markers become historical references; blank titles, oversized notes and unrepresentable estimates import flagged for review; identical live/archive copies collapse and divergent copies block. History view with search and family restore.
rows.acceptance: September 24 backup: 4,275 archived records map (1,778 young after 95 duplicates, 2,497 old), 5,369 historical references, 9 review flags, 32 collapsed and 63 blocking divergent copies. Remaining: archive timeTracking (#41), recurrence (#42), linked issues (#30) and a qualification import after the source duplicates are resolved (#47).
rows.offlineSync: History is online-only and outside the offline cache; archive/restore are revisioned HTTP writes. A currently archived task syncs as a removal; restore sends an upsert. Offline edits queued before an archive conflict and replay idempotently.

rows.mapping: Active interval tracking exists; source daily history, correction and reporting remain unqualified.
rows.acceptance: Reconcile leaf/parent totals and two old-archive mismatches, test manual corrections and imported reports.
rows.offlineSync: Immutable facts/corrections must not create duplicate intervals across clients.

rows.mapping: Source has daily/weekly/monthly/yearly, completion-based generation, inherited child templates and deleted instances; habits do not substitute.
rows.acceptance: Exercise wait-for-completion, repeat-from-completion, pause, missed work, monthly-last-day/week and child templates.
rows.offlineSync: Server-owned occurrence generation with durable identities and replay.

rows.mapping: Owner-scoped notes (Markdown text rendered as a safe subset) attach to one project, one tag or neither, with pinned-to-Today and order; SP note content/projectId/isPinnedToToday/created and project noteIds order import. Image notes and legacy project/tag notes text still block; markdown-checklist and plainspace workflows remain unmapped.
rows.acceptance: Note CRUD/reorder with owner isolation and revision conflicts through UI and assistant; imported notes keep association, order, content and links; replay creates no duplicates.
rows.offlineSync: Notes are online-only: not in the sync change feed, not cached offline; writes require HTTP with If-Match revisions.

rows.mapping: One imported issue link per task keeps provider key, provider instance ID, issue ID, last-updated time and last-synced values as provenance (ADR 0021); a Gitea issue address is rebuilt from the provider host and repository. Links to providers absent from the export are kept and reported. LINK/IMG web addresses open; NOTE text imports; local files, local images and commands are inert unavailable records. Owners add, edit and remove link and note attachments. Provider credentials are never read; live polling, issue refresh and write-back need a fresh provider authorization that does not exist yet.
rows.acceptance: Recover linked issues and supported attachments; preserve missing/external references and require fresh authorization.
rows.offlineSync: Links and attachments are online-only: outside the sync change feed and offline cache; writes require HTTP with If-Match revisions. No provider operations run.

rows.mapping: Per-task start reminders (six source offsets or none) and timed-deadline reminders use the ntfy delivery ledger per ADR 0020; exact remindAt/deadlineRemindAt offsets import, others block. The legacy reminders section and reminderId stay blocked.
rows.acceptance: Preserve six source task reminders plus deadline rules, timezone semantics, suppression and non-duplication.
rows.offlineSync: Server delivery ledger remains authority; reminder settings are online-only, so offline drafts cannot imply sent reminders.

rows.mapping: Source board/section/task-view state has no qualified Tadooer mapping.
rows.acceptance: Preserve board/section/order and view semantics; test moved/archived references.
rows.offlineSync: Define structural sync and competing reorder rules.

rows.mapping: Source counters and metric history are not equivalent to habit streaks.
rows.acceptance: Reconcile counts/units/history, then exercise increment/decrement/edit/delete with provenance.
rows.offlineSync: Define idempotent increments and concurrent edit policy.

rows.mapping: Tadooer has server-authoritative focus/break/takeover; source preferences and idle disposition require parity.
rows.acceptance: Exercise focus modes, idle-time allocation, breaks and tracking reminders without duplicate worklog intervals.
rows.offlineSync: Retain lease/controller semantics; offline focus remains an explicit unsupported boundary until designed.

rows.mapping: Preserve opaque plugin data; do not run imported code or credentials. Source API and plugin implementations are separately inventoried.
rows.acceptance: Map plugin capabilities and installed metadata to permissioned equivalents or an explicit extension contract.
rows.offlineSync: Plugin state must follow the same ownership and synchronization rules as app state.

rows.mapping: Planning/preferences exist; safe application config and shortcuts need mapping. Secret/provider configuration is intentionally excluded.
rows.acceptance: Qualify keyboard/navigation/contextual views, onboarding and accessible responsive states; report excluded settings.
rows.offlineSync: Separate durable preferences from transient selection/panel/runtime state.

rows.mapping: Google/Baikal federation exists; plugin calendars and opt-in canonical bridge need qualification.
rows.acceptance: Complete mapped provider journeys, recurrence/conflicts/revocation and original source calendar linkage.
rows.offlineSync: Server-owned provider sync; no closed-browser claim until scheduler qualification.

rows.mapping: PWA and Linux packaging exist; platform-specific native delivery requires explicit platform design.
rows.acceptance: Record exact supported workflows and physical-device gaps without claiming native mobile parity.
rows.offlineSync: Platform credential/offline/background behavior remains separately gated.

rows.mapping: Store-rating prompts and engagement presentation are not migrated data; decide relevant product outcomes under post-parity discovery.
rows.acceptance: Record an explicit disposition; do not count omitted source presentation as delivered workflow parity.
rows.offlineSync: No new synced entity is implied.

rows.mapping: Structured capture parses +project, #tag, @time and !deadline against existing names; source estimates, tag creation, URL handling and markdown/email paste have no equivalent.
rows.acceptance: Capture with estimate syntax, a new tag and a pasted markdown list produces the previewed tasks through UI, quick-add and assistant.
rows.offlineSync: Capture currently requires a connection; state the offline policy with the implementation.

rows.mapping: Source iCal URL subscriptions, event-to-task conversion, auto-import tombstones and hidden events have no Tadooer mapping.
rows.acceptance: Subscribe to an iCal URL, convert an event to a task twice without duplicates, and hide an event without deleting source data.
rows.offlineSync: Server-side refresh; subscriptions never write upstream.

rows.mapping: Sync v2 queues task create/patch/status/delete and habit commands only; planned time, planned day, reminder settings, project/tag assignment, project/tag lifecycle and checklist writes are online-only.
rows.acceptance: Two-profile offline edit, reconnect and conflict for each listed entity without lost or duplicated writes.
rows.offlineSync: Add sync v2 operations with field-level conflicts and idempotent replay.

rows.mapping: Source offers full JSON export, restore and automatic local backups; Tadooer has only the operator SQLite backup CLI.
rows.acceptance: Export all user data, restore into an empty instance and match counts and representative records.
rows.offlineSync: Export reads the server authority; restore uses preview and identity checks.

rows.mapping: Source syncs through Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, local file, Nextcloud or SuperSync with optional end-to-end encryption. Owner decision September 24 (#94): neither third-party storage sync nor client-side end-to-end encryption is a parity requirement; Tadooer keeps self-hosted server sync.
rows.acceptance: None; excluded by owner decision.
rows.offlineSync: Self-hosted server sync with the offline outbox (ADR 0010).
